The Entra account of a row carried out before the identifier existed

entra_fill.Rd

Item 11 of the 0.27.0 (decided on 2026-11-12): the rows the channel carried out before applied_entra_id existed have none, and get it from the sweep, with a guard. The account that carries the username carried out now is the one served only if it was born before the row was first carried out under that name: since is the first seal of the newest run of executions of that name, report_person_since(), in Rome's civil time and to the minute as the log stamps it. The reference is the first seal of the run and not the last: with the last, a name given again and then an execution for a change of role would pass. The run goes across a closure on a person gone from Entra (across_closures, item 14 of the limits, 0.29.0): a row set back to active after it, or granted again after it by an earlier version, is dated from the first execution of the name, not from the reopening.

Usage

entra_fill(
  executed_username,
  directory,
  since,
  revoked = FALSE,
  folds = directory_folds(directory)
)

Arguments

executed_username

The username the row was carried out for.

directory

The sweep, as directory_users() returns it.

since

"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M" in Rome, as report_person_since() answers; character() or NA when the log does not say.

revoked

Whether the row asks for revoked.

folds

The sweep folded, directory_folds(), made from directory; by default folded here.

Value

A list with id, the identifier to write or "", code, TRASPORTO_NOME_RIASSEGNATO or "", and undecided, TRUE when the guard cannot decide.

Details

  • Born before the end of that minute, createdDateTime read in UTC (report_graph_time()): the identifier is written, with no message.

  • Born after: on a row not revoked TRASPORTO_NOME_RIASSEGNATO and no identifier; on a revoked row neither.

  • Nobody carrying the name, or no name: nothing to say.

  • Two accounts carrying the name, no since or one that does not read, a date of creation that does not read, an identifier the door would refuse: the guard cannot decide, undecided.

The last two write nothing and stop nothing, and the next round tries again. The caller tells them apart on a row closed on a person gone from Entra and set back to active, which stops for IT when the guard cannot decide (item 14 of the limits, 0.29.0); on every other row both are nothing.

An account born in the same minute as the first seal passes: the log has minutes and Graph seconds, and a creation precedes the first execution by a round. An older account renamed onto the name freed by a deleted one passes too, the one case the guard does not see.
